name: mingle
description: Mingle, plateforme d'échange de services gratuits entre particuliers

scripts.postinstall: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -c green,yellow -n front,back "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
